name: Caffeine
description:
Tamperproof, sovereign infrastructure for AI-built software. Caffeine deploys every app you build onto the Internet Computer (ICP): a sovereign, serverless cloud that stays under your control. Unlike a normal cloud account, your apps can't be taken down or shut off; they're built to be immune to infrastructure hacks and traditional cyber attacks; and every upgrade is checked so a change can't silently lose your data. The result is tamperproof serverless software with safe upgrades and no vendor lock-in — your software and data stay yours.

On top of that infrastructure, Caffeine is an AI app builder for on-demand app creation. You describe the software you want in plain language, and Claude and Caffeine build and ship it for you — a complete full-stack web app, hosted in one place, with no servers or databases to set up. Create an app in one message and refine it just by chatting. It's a no-code way to create custom software on demand, for you or your AI agent.

Your apps don't stop at being tools, either. Their data becomes a living model of your business you can simply ask: pose a plain-language question like "which project is most profitable?" and get an answer instead of building a dashboard, so your software doubles as a source of insights.

With this connector, Claude is your hands-on build partner: create from a prompt, refine by conversation, follow live build sessions, preview each draft, and manage every project in one place. A caffeine.ai account is required, and while read-only actions run seamlessly, anything that creates, changes, or deletes a project always asks first.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Caffeine to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Caffeine to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.caffeine.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Caffeine MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Caffeine lists 21 MCP tools, including caffeine_auth_status, caffeine_chat_active_sessions, caffeine_chat_detach_session, caffeine_chat_list, caffeine_chat_reply, caffeine_chat_resume_session, caffeine_chat_send, caffeine_chat_session_feed, caffeine_chat_session_status, caffeine_chat_session_transcript, caffeine_chat_start_session, and caffeine_chat_submit_form.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Caffeine?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Caffeine in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Caffeine requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Caffeine is developed by Caffeine Labs AG. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
